app.title: Pet Food Calculator
app.description: Estimate how many calories a dog or cat needs per day, and how many grams of food to feed.
app.name: Luna

home.title: What do you want to know?
home.intro: Course formulas for dogs and cats, with every step shown.

food.title: Analyze a food
food.text: Carbohydrate, energy, dry matter and nutrients per 1000 kcal from a food label.

feed.title: Feed my pet
feed.text: How many calories your pet needs each day, and how much food to give.

check.title: Check the diet
check.text: Is the food enough for your pet? Nutrients and water per day.

tools.title: Tools

feed.title: How much should my pet eat?
feed.intro: Two quick steps. The results update as you type.
feed.disclaimer: This is an estimate. Every animal is different. Check your pet’s weight and body shape often, and ask your vet before big changes.

step1.title: Daily calorie needs
step1.subtitle: Find out how many calories your pet needs each day.
step1.weightError: Please type a number, like 12 or 4.5
step1.idealNote: For weight loss or gain, type the **ideal** weight, not the current weight.
step1.emptyBoth: Type the weight and pick one option above.

step2.title: Daily food amount
step2.subtitle: Turn calories into grams of your pet's food.
step2.energyHelp: Look on the food label for “Calorie content” and use the **kcal/kg** number.
step2.energyLowWarn: This number looks small for kcal per kg. Check that the label says kcal/kg, not kcal per cup or per can.
step2.perMeal: = **{grams} g** per meal, {meals} meals a day
step2.resultSub: For {kcal} kcal per day, food with {density} kcal/kg
step2.emptyStep1: Finish step 1, then type the kcal/kg from the label.
step2.emptyEnergy: Type the kcal/kg from the food label.

kgPerDay.title: Divide the energy need by the energy in the food

nfeSum.title: Add protein, fat, fibre, moisture and ash

atwaterEach.title: Energy of each nutrient: grams × factor

shareEach.title: Each share = its kcal ÷ total kcal × 100

shareCheck.title: Check: the shares add up to about 100 %

dmEnergy.title: Energy in the dry matter: kcal/kg ÷ (DM % ÷ 100)

food.title: Analyze a food
food.intro: Type the numbers from the label. Results update as you type.

input.title: The food
input.subtitle: Guaranteed analysis, as fed (the numbers on the label).
input.name: Name (optional)
input.ashHelp: No ash on the label? Dry food usually has {dry}, wet food {wet}.
input.labelEnergyHelp: If the label gives kcal/kg, the app uses it. If not, it uses the estimate.
input.addHelp: Calcium, phosphorus, vitamins … from the label or a typical analysis.

compare.title: Compare with
compare.subtitle: Guidelines used to judge the results.
compare.standardNote: NRC tables are not in the app yet, so FEDIAF is used.

results.title: Results
results.carbOver: These numbers add up to more than 100 %. Check the label.
results.usedLabel: Per 1000 kcal and AAFCO use the label energy.
results.usedEstimate: No label energy: per 1000 kcal and AAFCO use the estimate.
results.light: AAFCO “light” dry dog food: at most {max} kcal/kg
results.dmEnergyWarn: {kcal} kcal/kg DM is outside {min}–{max}. % DM tables can mislead here: use per 1000 kcal.
results.densityEmpty: Add a nutrient above to see more.
results.aafcoSub: The % this food would have at {standard} kcal/kg ({form} food).
results.caPNeeds: Add calcium and phosphorus to see the ratio.
